faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Does Filenest work offline? Is my data uploaded to the cloud?
faq.a1: Filenest is fully local: OCR, AI analysis and storage all run on your Mac. Zero cloud uploads. The only network request is license validation, and it carries no document data. The app works as usual while offline.
faq.q2: What does Filenest actually do for me?
faq.a2: Think of it as a private assistant with a perfect memory. Drop files in and it reads them, files them under the right client, and reminds you before anything expires. Months later you can simply ask what was in the file you handed over, and it finds the document and gives you the answer.
faq.a3: It's built for immigration consultants, lawyers, accountants, and every multitasking professional. The idea came from a real moment: juggling several jobs, the creator was asked about a document submitted to a company six months earlier, and lost hours digging for it. One thought stuck: what if I could just ask an assistant to hand me that company's file? Filenest is that assistant. The more you juggle, the more you need it.
faq.a4: Macs with Apple silicon running macOS 12 or newer. A Windows version is in development.
faq.a5: Your library database is encrypted with AES-256 (SQLCipher) and can only be opened with your key. Files stay in a folder you choose, with verified local backups. Nothing ever leaves your machine.
faq.a6: Yes. Download Filenest and start a free trial. No account or credit card needed. When you're ready, pick monthly, annual or lifetime.
